$comment: Sample fsi_cbgentitlementmaterialized rows written by the switch-on-pathway entitlement engine (see docs/entitlement-contract.md). Illustrative only — keys are Dataverse LOGICAL column names (see docs/dataverse-schema.md). Option-set columns show the integer value Dataverse stores; the readable label is in fsi_notes. fsi_pathway: 100000000=none, 100000001=mcp-cs, 100000002=mcp-agentbuilder, 100000003=api-direct, 100000004=metered, 100000005=unmapped. fsi_decision: 100000000=Allow, 100000001=Block, 100000002=Allow - Eligibility N/A, 100000003=Fail-open - Anomaly, 100000004=Fail-closed - Zero-rating Unresolved. fsi_decisionreason: 100000000=No eligible cohort, 100000001=Missing license, 100000002=Zero-rating unresolved - fail-closed, 100000003=Not in credit scope, 100000004=Policy cap exceeded, 100000005=Unmapped pathway. fsi_relatedcoveragegapid is a lookup; bind on PATCH with "fsi_RelatedCoverageGapId@odata.bind": "/fsi_cbgcoveragegaps(<guid>)". UPNs are example identities, not real.

value.fsi_notes: pathway=none -> ALLOW (eligibility N/A); explicit non-deny arm. Non-metered agent, no billing decision required.
pathway=metered; user is in an eligible credit cohort -> ALLOW.
pathway=metered; bounded ELSE -> BLOCK (No eligible cohort). User is in no eligible billing cohort for a metered agent.

pathway=mcp-cs; user holds a Copilot license but the zero-rating conflict is unresolved (fsi_zeroratingresolved=false) and the user is not in credit scope -> FAIL-CLOSED. Re-evaluate after the June 2026 Licensing Guide.
pathway=unmapped -> FAIL-OPEN with anomaly; classifier could not map the pathway. Short TTL so the decision is recomputed soon after the classifier is corrected.
